conventions.opd: nu_pump - nu(85Rb F=2 -> F'=3), ordinary frequency in GHz
conventions.tpd: nu_seed = nu_pump - nu_HF + delta; ordinary frequency delta in MHz
conventions.source_gain: Output signal power / input seed power; detection loss is excluded from calibration.
conventions.calibration_policy: Only Gold representative probe gain 15.5 may be fitted. Freeze that fitted parameter for held-out comparisons.
conventions.validation_policy: Gold agreement is calibration. McCormick/Liu are conditional literature comparisons with unresolved source assumptions; no independent gain-gradient or physical-squeezing validation is claimed.
conventions.uncertainty_policy: Null means unknown, never zero. Approximate ranges and decimal arithmetic are not statistical uncertainties.
conventions.conditional_model_inputs: Runtime defaults not listed in params (including transit rate, collision/dephasing law, empirical residual and polarization factors) are model assumptions, not measured source fields.

notes: Choose the canonical compilation target 15.5 once; retain approximately 15-16 and raw power ratios separately.
Gain definition is output probe power divided by input seed power; approximate gain-scan and IDS-operation values are not a single precision power-calibrated observation.
Setup text uses 10 uW seed; the selected IDS paragraph explicitly uses 8 uW.
The final primary source explicitly calls 530/330 um 1/e^2 radii; the CSV beam-context caveat is stale.
Calibration does not use output conjugate gain, detection efficiency, squeezing, excess noise, or held-out observations.

held_out.gain_convention: Measured effective probe gain Geff is cell-output/input probe power, corrected for window losses (p. 3). Intrinsic distributed-amplifier G=9-15 is a different model-derived observable.
limitations: Exact excited hyperfine OPD reference is unspecified.
Setup seed is approximately 100 uW; finite-seed comparison is conditional on that representative input.
Low-frequency-run powers 305/290 uW occur in a separate paragraph; dividing them by the setup 100 uW would create an unsupported matched-condition observation.
Reported paper +4 MHz two-photon detuning maps to GABES -4 MHz; rounded 3040 MHz spacing maps to -4.267561 MHz. Check sensitivity if a narrow gain feature makes this difference material.
Transit/ground-coherence, unresolved polarization participation, and apparatus loss planes are not independently calibrated by this record.

held_out.gain_convention: Approximate output/input seed ratios for the same stated 400 mW operating condition.
limitations: Exact excited F' OPD reference and explicit waist-intensity convention are incomplete.
Output powers are approximate; absolute measurement-plane and gain uncertainty are unknown.
Pump-off 90% probe transmission is not symmetric post-cell detector efficiency and must not be absorbed into gain correction.
Pump scan from 100 to 700 mW measures SQL-crossing squeezing bandwidth from 5.5 to 16.5 MHz; these endpoints are not measured gain targets.
Transit/ground-coherence and unresolved participation values remain conditional inherited model inputs.

reasons: Natural-abundance vapor differs from pure-85Rb production model.
Cell-length source conflict: CSV 19 mm versus accessible arXiv v1 approximately 8 mm effective Brewster-tilted path; final wording unresolved.
Exact excited hyperfine OPD reference and rounded 3.030 GHz spacing limit precision.
Primary source uses blue seed; hotfix calibration concerns standard red-seeded branch.
Exact TPD missing; gain 4-10 is a range and CSV 7 is its representative midpoint.
Dual-seeded low-frequency IDS is a different mode from single-seeded comparison.
CSV probe 129 uW and conjugate 17 uW are not a matched twin-beam pair: same output channel from 6.4 and 0.9 uW seed runs.
TPD sign is insufficiently defined for exact regression.
Vacuum-seeded homodyne experiment; classical seed gain target and seed waist absent.
Seeded experiment and useful stability observations, but curated table has no representative probe gain or matched output/input pair.
Conjugate output 218 uW and representative seed 12 uW are not established as one matched gain condition.
OPD, input seed, and source gain target missing.
Fiber collection/spatial filtering changes measurement class.
Both beam waists missing; do not fill them with Gold values.
Preprint noise/loss definitions unresolved; nominal gain approximately 15 at 300 mW is qualitative context only.
